prompt: Re-run the throughput test to confirm the environment issue.

text: A clean re-run on the same firmware separates a lab problem from a firmware one. Each plan runs once, so this needs a new approved plan.

args.title: Re-run · TC-PERF-003 · fw 2.1.0
args.rationale: Confirm the environment diagnosis for the throughput failure.

items.rationale: Same test and firmware as the failed run. A pass confirms the switch port flap caused the failure.

text: TC-PERF-003 **passed** on the re-run ({{report_id}}): 931.0 Mbps average [[ev:{{test_run:TC-PERF-003}}/check/throughput]] with 0.20 % retransmissions [[ev:{{test_run:TC-PERF-003}}/check/retrans]], and no link events on the lab switch. Same firmware, same test: this confirms the environment diagnosis. The earlier failure came from the SW-01 `Gi1/0/7` flap, not from firmware 2.1.0.
